html:
The Eritrean War of Independence was fought from 1961 to 1991 by Eritrean rebels against Ethiopia, and ended when they took Asmara in May 1991.

It began with the first shots fired by Hamid Idris Awate in the western lowlands. The Eritrean Liberation Front was joined and then pushed aside by the Eritrean People's Liberation Front, which held out in the mountains around Nakfa against the large army of the Derg, armed by the Soviet Union.

The rebels captured Massawa in 1990 and entered Asmara on 24 May 1991, as allied rebels took Addis Ababa. Independence was confirmed by the referendum of 1993. The war's self-reliance and discipline still shape the state of Isaias Afwerki.
sum: The Eritrean War of Independence was fought from 1961 to 1991 by Eritrean rebels against Ethiopia, and ended when they took Asmara in May 1991.
